tools.name: get_online_count
tools.title: Get online player count
tools.description: Returns the current approximate number of players online on BetSpace, matching the count displayed on the site.

tools.name: get_recent_wins
tools.title: Get recent public wins
tools.description: Returns the most recent public wins across BetSpace casino games (game, amount in COP, multiplier, timestamp).

limit.description: Maximum number of wins to return (1-20). Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_top_winners
tools.title: Get today's top winners
tools.description: Returns today's top winners on BetSpace. Choose the 'general' casino leaderboard or the 'arena' leaderboard.

board.description: Which leaderboard to return. Defaults to 'general'.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (1-10). Defaults to 10.
